description: Thresholds for the daily alert engine. The refresh job (skills/client-control-center-refresh) reads this file, evaluates each enabled rule against the Campaign Forge data, and writes data/alerts.json. Tune values here — no code changes needed.

rules.desc: API returns an auth/permission error for an account (e.g. 403 USER_PERMISSION_DENIED).
Account status is not ACTIVE / is disabled or under billing hold.
Daily spend exceeds trailing 7-day average by more than threshold_pct.
Daily spend falls below trailing 7-day average by more than threshold_pct.
Campaign daily spend is at/above threshold_pct of its daily budget (scaling opportunity).
Month-to-date spend projects above threshold_pct of the monthly target.
Campaign spent more than min_spend (account currency) with 0 conversions over the window.
Campaign CPA exceeds the account's best/blended CPA by more than this multiple.
ROAS drops below threshold_ratio of the trailing 30-day baseline.
CTR falls below threshold_ratio of the trailing baseline (creative fatigue).
No rows / zero activity returned for longer than this many hours while campaigns are enabled.
Campaign is ACTIVE/ENABLED but recorded 0 impressions over the window.
